  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/md4c/src/md4c.c","function":"md_build_attribute","line":null,"var":"raw_text[raw_off]","code":"Copy entity text into the temporary attribute buffer with memcpy(build->text + off, raw_text + raw_off, ent_end - raw_off)","note":"The entity bytes are propagated into a newly built attribute string used by later span rendering."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/md4c/src/md4c.c","function":"md_process_inlines","line":null,"var":"MD_TEXT_ENTITY","code":"Emit MD_TEXT_ENTITY for the entity token during inline processing","note":"The parser classifies the attacker-controlled sequence as entity text, preserving the exact bytes for the renderer."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/md4c/src/md4c-html.c","function":"render_entity","line":209,"var":"text","code":"Decode the entity and append the translated bytes to the HTML output callback","note":"The renderer expands the crafted entity into output bytes, and the vulnerable target crashes when processing the malformed c-string input described in the task."}
]
